name: NotInitialized
description: The vault contract has been deployed but initialize() has never been called. No operations are possible.
common_triggers: Calling deposit, withdraw, or harvest before initialize is invoked
Client configured with the wrong contract ID
The initialize transaction failed silently and was not retried
resolution: Call initialize(admin, underlying_token, signers) as the deployer. If you are a user, contact the protocol admin — the vault is not yet live.

name: AlreadyInitialized
description: initialize() was called on a vault that has already been set up. This is a one-time operation.
common_triggers: Running an initialization script twice
Deployment automation that does not guard against double-init
Attempting to re-initialize after a Wasm upgrade
resolution: Guard deployment scripts with a pre-check (e.g., verify total_assets() returns without error). To change admin or token, use governance proposals instead.

name: InsufficientShares
description: The caller tried to withdraw more shares than their account currently holds.
common_triggers: Entering a raw token amount instead of a share count
Shares already redeemed in a previous transaction
Race condition in automated withdrawal logic
Querying balance_of for the wrong address
resolution: Call balance_of(<your_address>) to confirm your actual share balance before withdrawing. Do not confuse shares with underlying token amounts.

name: InsufficientUnderlying
description: The vault does not hold enough underlying tokens to pay out the redemption amount. This should be extremely rare under normal operation.
common_triggers: Underlying token contract exploit draining vault funds
Misconfigured fee withdrawal removing more tokens than intended
State drift between total_deposited and actual token balance (typically preceded by BalanceMismatch)
resolution: Compare total_assets() with the on-chain token balance. If there is a significant discrepancy, stop interacting and alert the protocol admin immediately.

name: ZeroAmount
description: A zero or negative amount was passed to a function that requires a strictly positive value. Also fires when a deposit is so small the share formula rounds to zero.
common_triggers: Submitting a form without a valid amount
Passing 0 to deposit(), withdraw(), or harvest()
Deposit amount too small relative to current vault size (share formula floors to zero)
resolution: Ensure the amount is strictly positive. For very small deposits, increase the amount to guarantee at least 1 share: minimum_deposit = ceil(total_assets / total_shares).

name: MathOverflow
description: An intermediate arithmetic value exceeded the i128 maximum (2^127 - 1). The contract uses checked arithmetic throughout to detect this safely.
common_triggers: Passing an astronomically large amount value
Large total_assets combined with a large new deposit causing intermediate overflow
Automation passing raw floating-point values instead of scaled integers
resolution: Use i128-safe arithmetic in your client. Cap amount values at a reasonable maximum. All token amounts should be in the smallest indivisible unit (e.g., stroops).

name: InvalidAddress
description: An address argument is invalid or a fee parameter is outside the permitted range. Used as a combined sentinel for address validation and fee bounds checks.
common_triggers: perf_fee_bps > 2000 (more than 20%) passed to set_fees
mgmt_fee_bps > 100 (more than 1%) passed to set_fees
Alternate yield token not registered by admin via register_yield_token
Malformed Stellar address string
resolution: Ensure perf_fee_bps is 0–2000 and mgmt_fee_bps is 0–100. For alternate yield tokens, verify the address has been whitelisted by the admin.

name: ZeroShares
description: harvest() was called when total_shares is zero — no depositors exist. Yield cannot be distributed when the depositor pool is empty.
common_triggers: Keeper bot calling harvest before any deposits have been made
All depositors withdrew and the keeper continued harvesting
Harvesting against a newly initialized vault with no deposits yet
resolution: Check total_assets() before calling harvest. Only harvest when total_assets() > 0. Add this guard to automated keeper scripts.

name: UpgradeUnauthorized
description: A non-admin address attempted to call upgrade(). Wasm upgrades are restricted to the configured admin address.
common_triggers: Signing the upgrade transaction with a user keypair instead of the admin keypair
Admin key rotated via governance but upgrade scripts not updated
Old admin key used after a successful propose_update_admin execution
resolution: Sign the upgrade transaction with the current admin keypair. If the admin key has changed, retrieve the new admin address from governance proposal history.

name: StorageLayoutMismatch
description: The new Wasm being uploaded has a different CURRENT_LAYOUT_VERSION than what is recorded on-chain. This prevents silent state corruption when a migration is required.
common_triggers: Deploying a version that added storage keys without running the migration script first
Building from a branch that bumped CURRENT_LAYOUT_VERSION without reading the release notes
Uploading the wrong .wasm file
resolution: Check CURRENT_LAYOUT_VERSION in aura-vault/src/storage.rs for both the current on-chain version and the new Wasm. Follow the migration guide in the release notes. Rebuild from the correct source if needed.

name: VaultPaused
description: The admin has activated the emergency pause. All state-changing operations are blocked. Read-only queries (total_assets, balance_of, is_paused) remain available.
common_triggers: Admin detected suspicious activity and manually paused the vault
Scheduled maintenance
Automated circuit breaker triggered
resolution: Call is_paused() to confirm. Your funds are safe. Monitor official channels for a resumption announcement. Admin: call unpause() once the issue is resolved.

name: BalanceMismatch
description: The vault's recorded total_deposited does not match the actual on-chain token balance. This is the flash-loan guard. A suspicious event is emitted alongside this error.
common_triggers: Flash-loan attack attempting to inflate or deflate vault balance
Tokens sent directly to the vault contract address outside of deposit()
Bug in a wrapper contract that interacts with vault token accounts incorrectly
resolution: Regular users: retry once; if it persists, stop interacting and check the protocol status page. Developers: never send tokens directly to the vault address — always use deposit(). Admins: inspect the suspicious event for observed vs. expected amounts and consider pausing.
